verdict: Scope-(a) NEGATIVE, with one exact symbolic survivor that still fails numerically. The corpus supplies an independent, derived, q-independent 1/sqrt(2): the Verlinde/bwS0 vacuum amplitude S_00 = d_q/D of the n=2 (Hopf) bipartition — both blocks have d_q = 1 (Lean-witnessed), D = sqrt(2), reduced-density eigenvalues (1/2, 1/2), Schmidt amplitude 1/sqrt(2), entanglement entropy ln 2. But identifying the Borel-Laplace coupling with this bipartition amplitude is a relabel (no derivation; and S_00 is a fibre root-of-unity object while the coupling is archimedean — the standing bwS0_eq_hecke continuation open). Decisively: even granting x = 1/sqrt(2), the median resummation gives 0.44 MeV at eps=0.02 (20% of B_D; eps-sensitive 0.38-0.92 MeV, <= 41%, because the coupling sits ON the singularity), and the median sum's global max over the WHOLE coupling axis is ~0.46 MeV ~ 21% of B_D (plateau near x ~ 0.6) — it never reaches B_D at any coupling. This corrects the #3736 extrapolation ('reaches B_D as x -> 1/sqrt2') and dissolves Target 2's gate: no coupling derivation can close the resummation route. The two sqrt(2)'s share an origin (pair structure: the x^2/2 2-cycle term of the involution EGF vs the 2 blocks of n=2) — a shared origin, not an identification. Working deuteron channel remains the q-rotational mu0*hbar_q*J_q^2 (-9%, 0 params). No fit; no wiring; no tier change.
scope: (a) — exact symbolic 1/sqrt(2) exists (S_00 at n=2) but its identification with the trans-series coupling is underived (relabel; fibre-vs-archimedean gap), and even granted it the resummation undershoots 2.4-5x; the median sum never reaches B_D at any coupling (plateau ~21%)
